title: Juicy Sweetie Pork Shoulder
description: A quick and delicious Filipino dish featuring sweet and juicy pork shoulder that's perfect for those with diabetes-friendly needs.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: For soaking the pork shoulder for easier slicing

ingredients.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
ingredients.notes: Apple cider vinegar for tanginess and moisture retention

instructions: Submerge the pork shoulder in water, covering it completely. Soak overnight.
Drain the pork shoulder and pat dry with paper towels.
Mix soy sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar into a marinade. Apply this mixture evenly over the pork shoulder, making sure all areas are coated.
Place the pork shoulder in a baking dish and bake for 2 hours or until an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) is reached.
Reduce heat to 300°F (150°C), cover with foil, and continue cooking for another hour. Reduce heat further if necessary to prevent burning.
Let rest before slicing into chunks to serve.
